# JediCoop patch notes

## 0.32.2

You can still play with a partner who is on 0.32.1 or 0.32.0, but each fix only works in a game that has this update, so both of you should update.

**Fixes**
- Bracca: skipping the opening cutscene no longer leaves a second Prauf standing at the start.
- Bracca: the first big view over the scrapyard plays for both of you at the same time. Before, it could start for one of you minutes late, after you had already walked on.
- Bracca: the "Jump and press to climb." hint no longer stays on screen after you've climbed, and your partner's climbing no longer closes or skips yours.
- Bracca: Prauf's path through the scrapyard and the ladder that breaks under him are each player's own. Your partner getting there first no longer moves your Prauf on or breaks your ladder.
- Bracca: one press on the first or third clamp on the way to the wing moves that clamp for both of you, even when your partner is far away, and it never leaves either of you stuck. The second clamp is each player's own.
- Bracca: the wing slide and everything after it up to saving Prauf are each player's own. The cutscene before the slide starts when your own character gets there, never earlier because of your partner. If you both start the slide at about the same time, you see each other on it.
- Bracca: the slide down the wing after Prauf's fall is no longer extremely slow with no steering, and you're no longer moved forward after squeezing through on the way to it.
- Bracca: on the train, each of you plays the cars, their doors and Prauf leading you through them in your own game; your partner going ahead no longer changes your car or locks a door behind you. The door out of the last car waits for your partner while you're both still on the train, however far apart you are.
- Bracca: the console at the end of the Imperial corridor waits for your partner while you're both in the corridor, however far apart you are.
- Bracca: in the vision on the train, Jaro's training remote stays in your own game.
- Saber locks: a glowing clash effect no longer stays on your lightsaber after a shared saber lock with a boss.
- Purge Troopers no longer fight with their weapon held away from their hands (on their back) after your partner's game takes them over.
- Bogano: walking into the Researcher's home no longer tells you Oggdo Bogdo was defeated when nobody fought him.
- Bogano: BD-1's repair scene at the Researcher's home plays for each of you, and both of your BD-1s are mended.
- Controllers: on the title screen and the pause menu one press of the D-pad answers an invite. On Join Journey you can move down from the code to your invites and journeys. A controller that isn't the first one plugged in works for these too.
- If the game closes unexpectedly, your log now keeps a little more about what happened, so we can look into it when you send a report.

## 0.32.1

You can still play with a partner who is on 0.32.0, but each fix only works in a game that has this update, so both of you should update.

**Fixes**
- Bracca: at the lookout near the start, neither of you is left hanging on the ledge or waiting up to a minute for the view.
- Bracca: after skipping the cutscenes before the train, the game now checks that your lightsaber is visible and puts it right if not. Before, it could stay invisible until you died.
- Saber colours you earned in an earlier journey (and their trail) no longer show up on Bracca; they're back from Bogano onwards.
- Skipping the landing cutscene on Bogano no longer leaves the Mantis's ramp on the wrong side, out of reach.
- Boss health bars no longer show up on top of cutscenes.
- Your partner's name above their head no longer disappears after you alt-tab or change the game window's size.
- Hardcore: when something waits for both of you and your partner has died outright (from a fall, for example), it now goes ahead for the player who is left. Before, it could wait for ever.

## 0.32.0

Both of you need 0.32.0: it doesn't connect to a partner on 0.31.4 or older.

Coming from 0.30.12? This update also brings everything in 0.30.13 to 0.31.4 below. The big ones: every journey is now hardcore (if you go down, your partner has a short time to revive you; if they can't, you watch until they rest at a meditation point), and co-op now carries through the whole story.

**Bracca**
- Bracca's opening can be played in co-op. The train section, where the game teaches you to fight, is each player's own: your own enemies at their normal health.
- The door out of train car 3 waits for both of you, and you go through together. The scenes after it play for each of you on your own.
- Every new journey now starts on Bracca, played together this way. The BRACCA setting has left the co-op settings; journeys you've already begun carry on as they started.

**Boss fights**
- The Ninth Sister's final saber lock is shared, like her first two.
- The Ninth Sister's fight now ends properly when both of you have been hitting her.
- The Second Sister and Trilla behave the same for both of you through the whole fight.
- Optional bosses and mini-bosses follow the co-op boss rules, like the story bosses: more health with two players, and harder to stagger.
- Gorgara's wind gust and acid reach both of you.
- When you're both defeated, the boss always comes back at full health, whichever of you returns first.
- Gorgara: after you're both defeated she returns once both of you have dropped back into her lair.

**Story**
- Ordo Eris: the arena starts when both of you have walked in, and the Mantis leaves when both of you are aboard.
- Zeffo: the lift down to the Second Sister waits until both of you stand on it when you're together. The invisible wall before it is gone.
- When something waits for both of you and the player who pressed it goes down or dies before the other presses, that press is cancelled. Press it again when you're back.
- Earlier story moments on Kashyyyk, Zeffo and Dathomir were gone through again with hardcore on, and several waits that could leave one of you stuck are fixed.

**Hardcore**
- A player who is down or spectating can no longer swing their lightsaber.
- A boss turns away from a downed player sooner.

**Known**
- The Second Sister's and Trilla's grabs don't reach the joining player yet.

## 0.31.4

You can still play with a partner who is on 0.31.3, 0.31.2 or 0.31.1, but each fix only works in a game that has this update, so both of you should update.

**Fixes**
- Dathomir: when you're both defeated by Gorgara, the fight no longer counts as won for one of you. Before, that player could come back past the fight while their partner still had it ahead of them.
- Dathomir: when you drop back into Gorgara's lair one after the other, she returns once for both of you. Before, the second player's game could bring in a second Gorgara and then count the fight as won.
- Dathomir: after you're both defeated by Gorgara, the prompt at the body where the fight starts is the same for both of you, and neither of you is left waiting at it.

## 0.31.3

You can still play with a partner who is on 0.31.2 or 0.31.1, but each fix only works in a game that has this update, so both of you should update.

**Fixes**
- Hardcore: after you come back from spectating, enemies no longer walk through your hero. It happened mostly after a fall.
- Bogano: the vault's astrium no longer keeps you waiting when your partner died nearby and then pressed it on their own.
- A rare case where the joining player's co-op switched itself off in the middle of a session (your partner and the enemies froze, then the session dropped) is fixed.

## 0.31.2

You can still play with a partner who is on 0.31.1, but each fix only works in a game that has this update, so both of you should update.

**Fixes**
- The joining player's game no longer crashes when you're both defeated at the same moment.
- The game no longer crashes when you leave to the title screen.
- Zeffo: a player who wasn't on the lift when their partner rode it down can now attack, block and use the Force against the Second Sister.

## 0.31.1

Both of you need 0.31.1: it doesn't connect to a partner on 0.31.0 or older.

**Boss fights**
- The Ninth Sister's saber locks are shared, like Trilla's and Taron Malicos's: you're both pulled in together, and if either of you wins, you both do. Her final lock is as before.
- In every shared saber lock your partner is out of sight only until the lock's win or loss has played out, then they're back.
- Area attacks reach both of you: Taron Malicos's Force push, the Inquisitors' ground pound and the Temple Guardian's stomp now hit whichever of you they reach, not only one player.

**Fixes from the last playtest**
- When you both go down against Taron Malicos, he's back at full health on his platform, without the fallen rocks.
- A partner who is down stays visible during a saber lock, so you can still revive them.
- The game's HUD and your partner's marker no longer show over the end credits.
- Your partner no longer disappears for a moment stepping on or off the Mantis ramp.
- Vader can't catch you the moment his chase begins.
- Arriving at the Fortress: the landing scene plays for both of you.
- Fortress: the moonpool hatch and the alarm door wait for both of you, the dojo fights run in both games, the electricity puzzle counts for both of you once it's solved, and enemies that appeared for only one of you now appear for both.
- Enemies: an enemy killed in one game no longer stays alive in the other, dead enemies no longer keep moving or fly into the sky, Purge Troopers keep their batons in their hands, and a heavy gunner's minigun sound no longer loops forever.
- The sounds of your partner's fights get quieter with distance.
- The "FOLLOW?" prompt no longer stays up after you've both landed.

## 0.31.0

Both of you need 0.31.0: it doesn't connect to a partner on 0.30.24 or older.

**Co-op story: Dathomir**
- Jaro Tapal's second test and his farewell are each player's own, like the first test. Your partner is back once you've both come out.
- Taron Malicos: you go into his arena together (whoever gets there first waits at the entrance), he's the same boss in both games from his intro on, and he's tougher in co-op like the other arena bosses.
- The game no longer freezes at Merrin's scene during that fight. Shared scenes stay in step when one of you dies or restarts, and your partner's sparks and sounds no longer play twice in them.

**Co-op story: Bogano**
- Opening the vault: if you're together, you both press the astrium. If you're apart, each of you opens it on your own.
- Trilla's last saber lock is shared: if either of you wins it, you both do, and it doesn't start again afterwards.

**Co-op story: Fortress Inquisitorius**
- Trilla's fight starts when you both use the console, and her saber locks are shared: one win counts for both of you. A partner who is down or spectating isn't pulled into a lock.
- Vader's grab and the chase after it are each player's own. The lift at the end starts once you've both used its console.
- Hardcore: if one of you goes down during the chase, there's no revive. You watch your partner until they reach the next area, then you're back.
- Vader in the tube: you both open the hall door, and the final clash is shared: if either of you wins a part of it, you both do. A lost clash plays the death once, and no second Vader appears.

**Hardcore**
- Hardcore is now how co-op is played: every journey is hardcore, including ones you've already started and saves you port into co-op, and it's no longer an option in the co-op settings. If you fall, your partner has 20 seconds to revive you; if they don't, you watch them play until they rest at a meditation circle.
- When you both go down in a boss fight, the boss is back at full health when you return, as when you die alone in the game.

**Waiting for your partner**
- When the story holds you for your partner (a scene that waits for both of you, something you both have to press, or the way ahead blocked until they arrive), you're told you're waiting for them, so it doesn't look like the game is stuck. At the vault's astrium, you're also told when your partner has pressed it and is waiting for you.

**Your partner**
- Your partner's face should no longer look dark aboard the Mantis.

## 0.30.24

Works with 0.30.23: you can still play together with a partner who hasn't updated yet, but both of you should update. Some of these fixes need both of you on 0.30.24.

**Co-op story**
- When your partner uses a switch, console or panel far away, your hero no longer freezes or walks off towards it by itself.

**World**
- Things your partner breaks, cuts or uses while you're far apart no longer happen to the wrong thing in your game (for example a different rope shortcut coming down).
- Less stutter while the two of you are in different rooms of a big area, such as the Tomb of Eilram.

**Enemies**
- Enemies such as Zeffo's burrowing creatures no longer stand still until you hit them when your partner is far away or their game stops for a while.

**Sounds**
- Your partner's parries and swings now sound like theirs: a bit quieter than yours, from their side, and quieter the further away they are. Duels sound as before.

**Photo mode**
- In photo mode your partner holds still with the rest of the scene, and their poncho no longer stretches across the screen.

**Smoother play**
- Your partner and enemies no longer all jump forward at once after a stutter. Duels are unchanged.
- Joining a session no longer freezes the game for about a second.

## 0.30.23

Works with 0.30.22: you can still play together with a partner who hasn't updated yet, but both of you should update. Most of these fixes work in the game they're installed in.

**Co-op combat**
- A fully charged Force push into a wall no longer kills most small enemies outright in co-op: the wall slam does half its damage, so it usually takes two.
- Creatures that die in your partner's game (such as Zeffo's burrowing rats) no longer stay in yours with a health bar you can still hit.
- An enemy you're both fighting turns to the one attacking it, even when the attacks don't land (Zeffo's big brute could stay on whoever was blocking).
- Enemies in a fight your partner starts no longer flick between you while it begins.
- Less stutter when either of you Force-pulls an enemy.

**Enemy shots**
- The heavy trooper's minigun sound no longer keeps playing after you pull the trooper mid-burst.
- A rocket trooper aiming at your partner shows its warning glare in the right colour in both games, also from further away.
- A rocket's launch flash now shows in both games.
- A rocket trooper's reload rocket is no longer lit up like a flying rocket in its hand.

**Sounds**
- You now hear your partner's Force push, pull and slow.
- You hear the footsteps, shouts and other sounds of enemies your partner is fighting.
- A rocket trooper firing at your partner now makes its launch sound in your game too.

**World**
- Boxes you lift with the Force now move in your partner's game too.
- A block one of you pushed is no longer pushed again for both of you after a death.
- A door that locks again (for example during a fight) now opens for both of you when it unlocks.
- You no longer get stuck on a swing rope right after your partner swings on it.

**Co-op story: Ilum**
- Skipping the forge scenes no longer leaves you without BD-1.

**Smoother play**
- Fixed small stutters every few seconds in many areas.
- Fewer moments where enemies jump for a moment after a stutter or a load.
- Fixed two rare problems where JediCoop could switch itself off (when you arrived somewhere new, or after a few minutes of play), so co-op stopped working until you restarted the game.
- If JediCoop's messages ever fall back to the plain text box, they now go back to the game's own look by themselves.
- Getting on and off the Mantis no longer makes your partner vanish for a moment.

## 0.30.22

Works with 0.30.21: you can still play together with a partner who hasn't updated yet, but both of you should update: the crash fix protects the game it's installed in.

- Fixed a crash that could close both players' games in a fight with enemy health bars on screen, such as the bounty hunters.
- Boss health bars now stay on screen until the boss is defeated, in both players' games, instead of disappearing when the boss turns to the other player.

## 0.30.21

Both players need this update to play together.

**Co-op combat**
- Enemies share themselves between you. Walk into a group together and you both get a fight; arrive a little later and some of them come to meet you.
- Keep hitting an enemy that's fighting your partner and it turns on you. An enemy you both fight takes turns between you.
- Enemies switching from one of you to the other freeze and slide much less, and get back to attacking sooner.
- Force-push or pull your partner's enemy and it comes after you, instead of snapping back to them a few seconds later.
- Two against one is still a fight: hitting an enemy together no longer keeps it staggered forever. Guard breaks and parries still open it up.
- An enemy no longer flinches twice from one of your partner's hits.
- A finisher on an enemy your partner was fighting now ends it the first time (a security droid could be left lying on the floor alive).
- You can Force-pull probe droids your partner is fighting.
- New co-op journeys start with Tougher enemies (1.5x health); you can still change it. Journeys you already have keep their setting.

**Co-op bosses**
- Bosses share themselves between you the way other enemies now do: they stay on one of you longer, switch less, and spend less time standing around between you.
- Inquisitors finish their attacks and hit back when you both fight them, instead of staggering under two players. Parries, guard breaks and Force slow still open them up.
- Inquisitors have extra health in co-op, on top of your enemy health setting, so the fight lasts about as long as it would alone.

**Enemy shots**
- Enemy blaster bolts, arrows, rockets and grenades now appear in both players' games, with the same trails, sounds and explosions in the same place.
- When your partner blocks or parries a shot, you now see it fly back and hit, instead of the enemy just falling over.
- Pushing, pulling or slowing a rocket or grenade with the Force now looks the same for both of you.
- A rocket fired at your partner now explodes where it hit them on your screen too.
- Thrown grenades, including the AT-ST's, now go off for both players.

**Doors, bridges and platforms**
- Automatic doors now open in both games when your partner walks through them, so you no longer see them pass through a closed door.
- Dathomir's swinging wooden platforms now move in both games.
- A bridge your partner pulls down with the Force now comes down properly in your game too (fixes getting stuck at a Dathomir bridge).
- Bridges, walls and doors your partner opens with the Force while you're elsewhere are open when you get there.
- Joining a game now catches you up on bridges the host extended and ice they melted.

**Co-op story: Dathomir**
- Nightbrothers that come back after leaving now come back in both games.
- The temple door before Jaro Tapal's ghost no longer shuts the second player out when the first walks in.
- No more Malicos boss bar or live Malicos during the undead chase back to the ship.
- When your partner finishes the chase and their own scene starts, they disappear from your screen instead of flying off with the ship.

**Co-op story: Ilum**
- The temple's rope sockets stay plugged in for both of you, so the doors they open stay open.
- The ice wall your partner melts with the laser, and the swinging arm they move, change in your game too.
- At the forge each of you uses your own workbench and picks your own crystal colour.
- Skipping a scene should no longer leave fog inside the Mantis or lose BD-1 after the forge.

## 0.30.20

Works with 0.30.19: you can still play together with a partner who hasn't updated yet.

**Co-op story: Dathomir**
- The Gorgara: the climb up to her waits for both of you. Climb together and she only swoops in once you're both up there; if your partner is far away, you climb and face her alone.
- Jaro Tapal's ghost in the tomb is a fight each player has on their own, like the Order 66 memory before it. Your partner disappears for its length and is back once you've both come out.
- The undead chase back to the ship: if you both fall, you come back at your checkpoint instead of being dropped onto your partner and falling through the world.

**Co-op story: Ilum**
- The player who joined now sees the landing scene on arrival too.
- No more snow, fog or flicker inside the Mantis after your partner walks through the weather outside.
- The AT-STs by the frozen lake count as shared enemies from the moment the fight starts. Before, each game ran its own for up to a minute.
- Respawning after a fall far from your partner puts you back at your checkpoint on solid ground, no longer stuck falling in the void.

**Your partner**
- Your partner is lit the same way as you indoors (they looked washed-out white aboard the Mantis), and their BD-1 is the right size again.
- No more stray enemy voices and footsteps coming from where nobody is standing.

Works with 0.30.18: you can still play together with a partner who hasn't updated yet.

**Co-op bosses**
- The Ninth Sister's fight ends properly for both players: whoever lands the last blow gets the final button mash and the finisher, and she no longer freezes or dies early on the other player's screen.

**Hardcore**
- When both players die, both come back at the last checkpoint, even if the game's death screen doesn't appear.
- While spectating, your view stays with your partner through their falls, rides and meditation instead of snapping back to where you died.

**Co-op story**
- Dathomir: the wooden bridge one player pulls down now falls for the other player too, so both can cross.

**Stability**
- A crash when a pair of bounty hunters changed hands between the two games should be gone.

## 0.30.18

Works with 0.30.17: you can still play together with a partner who hasn't updated yet.

- Player names with slurs or hateful words in them aren't allowed any more. The other player sees a name like that as
  "Player", and the launcher asks for a new one before you play.

## 0.30.17

Both players need 0.30.17 to play together.

**Co-op story**
- Zeffo: when the bounty hunters capture one of you, they take you both to their ship. Wake up with REAWAKEN as usual.
- Zeffo: the plinths that work the temple's machines stay the same for both players, even when you use them at the same time, and the moving walls match.
- Zeffo: slicing a panel with BD-1 now extends the bridge and moves the platform for your partner too, and the panel no longer offers to be sliced again.
- Zeffo and Kashyyyk: landing on a planet plays the arrival scene once for each player.
- Kashyyyk: the celebration scene no longer leaves an extra stormtrooper behind.
- Kashyyyk: a lift ride now opens the door at the other end for both players.
- Doors you unlock now open for your partner too, not just unlock.
- If the health and stims bars are missing after a scene, they now come back.

**Co-op enemies**
- The spider from a web trap now appears for both players straight away.
- A fight you both come back to after riding a lift stays shared.
- An enemy's looping sound (like a heavy trooper's minigun) stops when it should.
- The fire orbs you pull out of the tomb walls show in your hands for your partner.

**Sound**
- You no longer hear your partner's stims as if they were your own.

**Workbench**
- The blade colours you've earned in duels show every time you open the workbench.

## 0.30.16

**Hardcore**
- New co-op journeys now start in hardcore. Journeys you've already started keep the mode they have.
- While spectating, if your partner has been idle for a while you can respawn by holding Interact.

**Co-op story**
- Bogano: BD-1's scans in the vault no longer play their voices twice, and the area after the wall-run lesson loads properly for both players.
- Zeffo: the way to the Second Sister now waits until you're both close, her reveal plays for both of you, her Force grab reaches both players, and there's only ever one of her.
- Zeffo: the plinth, the burning brambles and the rope plug in the temple now work the same for both players.
- Kashyyyk: the AT-ST fight on the roof no longer ends early with the celebration.
- Kashyyyk: the Ninth Sister fight starts when you both use the interaction, the saber locks are shared, and the end of the fight plays out properly for both players. Fixed a second Ninth Sister appearing and a crash near the end of the fight.
- Ordo Eris: boarding the Mantis now waits for both players, and the "waiting for" message goes away when the wait ends.
- Dathomir: the Shadowlands ambush now waits for both players, and its cutscene camera no longer jumps out and back.
- Dathomir: the wall that starts the rope ambush needs both of you to use it when you're together. Apart, each player starts their own.
- Dathomir: Gorgara's fight starts when you both use the body in her lair, and the lair fight is shared. The climb out, the snatch and the ride are each player's own. Fixed a second bat and an extra Nightbrother appearing.

**Co-op enemies and bosses**
- Boss health bars for your partner's fights come in on time and show the damage trail draining.
- A Brute losing an arm, and a Temple Guardian falling, now look right in your partner's game.
- Ranged enemies attack the other player more reliably.
- Fixed a crash when enemies spawn near both players (seen at Kashyyyk's spider webs).
- Fixed the game sometimes closing during a story scene.

**Duels**
- Trading hits mid-swing is fairer: the first hit lands sooner.

## 0.30.15

**Co-op menus**
- New pictures for eight locations in the journey menus: the Abandoned Village, the Auger Pulverizers, the Turbine Facility and the Imperial Dig Site on Zeffo; Cliffside Fortress, Upper Strangled Cliffs and the Collapsed Settlement on Dathomir; and the Fortress Inquisitorius.

## 0.30.14

**Co-op story**
- Bogano's story cutscenes now play for each player on their own: the vault scenes, BD-1's repair and healing lesson, and the discovery of Dathomir. So does Dathomir's first meeting with the Wanderer.
- Piloting the AT-AT on Kashyyyk is now each player's own, like the training memories.
- Kashyyyk's walking AT-AT now sets off once both players have arrived, so you both climb the same walker.
- Skipping Bracca now starts your journey on Bogano at the Abandoned Workshop meditation point, with BD-1 already at your side.
- Skipping a cutscene with keyboard and mouse is now done by holding the left mouse button (Esc opened the pause menu).

**Co-op world**
- Fixed the area around one player sometimes not loading on Bogano.
- Zeffo: the lift down to the tomb now moves for both players when one of you stands on the pressure plate.
- Zeffo: the wind windows in the tomb now open, with their wind, for both players.
- Zeffo: the lights in the dark cave come on for both players, and your partner is no longer pulled over to the switch (they could get stuck and fall while balancing).
- Force Push training: your partner's training balls no longer appear or hit you.
- Fixed the AT-ST pilot on Zeffo appearing twice for one player.

**Lightsaber workbench**
- The blade colours you've earned in duels now make the usual menu sounds at the workbench.

## 0.30.13

**Co-op story**
- Cutscenes that only tell the story now play for each player on their own, as they would solo: no more waiting for your partner to watch a conversation. Cutscenes that start a fight, bring in enemies or change the world still wait until you're both there.
- Upgrade scenes (BD-1 at a workbench) no longer wait for the other player.
- On Kashyyyk, the refinery door before the Purge Trooper, freeing the Wookiees at the console and the Wookiee cell door wait until both players are there.
- Fixed a cutscene that could play twice over itself or show a character twice.

## 0.9.0
The first version with the JediCoop launcher and join codes.

**Getting started**
- The JediCoop launcher finds your game (Steam or EA app), checks it's a supported version, and
  installs, updates or removes the mod with one click. It never changes the game's own files.
- Set your name once in the launcher; press Play to start the game with JediCoop.
- Back up your saves, or import a save a friend sent you, from the launcher.

**Play together**
- Host: press F6 in the game. You get a join code (like K7Q-X9R), already copied: paste it to your
  friend. No extra software or router settings needed.
- Join: copy the code, then press F7 in the game (or press F7 and type it).
- See your friend's Cal in your game, with lightsaber, poncho and BD-1.
- Fight together: shared enemies, damage and deaths in both games; blaster bolts, acid spit and
  baton strikes from enemies the other game runs hit you too, with the game's own knockback and
  sparks. Block bolts to stop them.
- Travel separately: each player flies their own Mantis. When one picks a planet, the other is
  asked "Follow? [Y] / [N]".
- Shared world: a shortcut door unlocked by one player opens for both; Force Slow on a puzzle
  object slows it in both games.
- Difficulty: Co-op (the normal game) or Scaled (tougher enemies for two players).

**Menus and messages**
- F4 opens the co-op menu (session, join code, keys, your name, difficulty, mod version).
- Join problems are explained: a wrong code, or a different mod or game version, says so plainly.

**Safety**
- Back up your saves from the launcher before playing together (one click, dated copies).

**Known limits**
- Force Slow on an object looks different in the other player's game.
- Parrying a bolt back only works for bolts aimed at you.
- Enemies alerted far from one player may stand still in that player's game until they're defeated.
- Some enemy types and bosses are untested.
